steps.content: Freed from the illusion, Hypatia drags in a ragged gasp. She clutches the dove to her chest and holds it there, unable to let go.
The agony from the brand still hasn't subsided; each breath is a slow, deliberate kind of torture.

steps.speaker: Dove
steps.content: Coo?
The dove, so ferocious a moment ago, now tilts its head and looks at her, nuzzling her cheek with tender comfort. A soft white light radiates from its small form, wrapping Hypatia in a calming glow.
The pain in her body suddenly recedes. Cradling the dove in her palms, Hypatia leans in, carefully returning the gentle nuzzle.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: ...Thank you.
The dove takes flight again, moving with nimble grace. It hovers a short distance ahead, suspended as if waiting for Hypatia to follow.

steps.speaker: Dove
steps.content: Over here. This way leads out of the Tear Zone. We'll make for the rendezvous. I've already located Rust. Let's move ahead and regroup with him.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: But I...
She bites back the words.
I want to explore deeper into the tear zone; I think I've detected unusual fluctuations. The sentence forms in her mind, clear and urgent, but she can't bring herself to say it out loud.
She is the one holding everyone back. Rust and Margaret have both stopped to wait for her. Without her, they might already be safe.
She led them into this peril. What right does she have to suggest they linger for further investigation?
What justification, other than a scholar's intuition—a guess, nothing more?
The dove, seemingly oblivious to her turmoil, grows impatient. It flutters up and down, darting ahead as if urging her to hurry.
Hypatia takes two hesitant steps forward, only to discover another dove has appeared behind her, in the opposite direction.
It's identical to the dove before her, emanating the same gentle, guiding radiance.
The realization hits like a physical chill: she is still trapped. The illusion hasn't broken.
Which way... should she go?
In the seconds she hesitates, two more doves materialize around her, then three, then countless others—reflected like fragments in a shattered mirror, each one dancing, beckoning.
Will you come with me?
The words seem to hum in the air, just beyond hearing.
Don't you want to follow?
And then, in perfect, unnerving unison, they wheel away, each taking a different path.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Wait—!
Wait! Don't go!

She dashes toward one of the light specks, but the sand beneath her gives way. It becomes soft, treacherous, as if the ground itself is against her. She stumbles, scrambles up, and runs again, hand straining toward that fleeing speck of white.
As if answering her plea, one of the doves wheels in a graceful arc and returns, hovering just before her.
Its form shifts, becoming the silhouette of a person.
The silhouette reaches out and takes her hand.
And just like in that dream, her palm meets a warmth that is utterly, undeniably real.

steps.speaker: Margaret?
steps.content: There, there, it's all right now. I won't let them harm you anymore.
Hypatia clutches her hand tightly. A gentle radiance flows from the point where their hands meet, a warmth so convincing she never wants to release it.
This is real. Undeniably, irreducibly real.
Margaret's voice reaches her then, soft and steady, comforting her in the same gentle way she always has.

steps.speaker: Margaret?
steps.content: You're simply exhausted. The destination is nearly in sight, which is why each step feels so heavy now. You have failed no one, Hypatia.
She places a comforting kiss on the girl's forehead.

steps.speaker: Margaret?
steps.content: The elderly scavenger looks toward the dilapidated amusement park, sighing.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: What... should I do...
Her breath shudders as the brand on her neck burns deep into the marrow, sharpening the torment in her mind.
Yet she clutches Margaret's hand, stubborn, refusing to let go.

steps.speaker: Margaret?
steps.content: You will find those flowers. You will bring the promise of the Hypercubes to the farlands. This is not a place for you to linger. Rest a moment, and then continue on your way.
Margaret's gaze holds a gentle smile; even the wind around her seems to soften. A fine, sharp sting pricks Hypatia's dried-out eyes.
But just as she begins to elaborate on her discovery, she sees that Margaret's form is dissolving.
Even the warmth in her hand is fading.
The warmth vanishes. The illusion dissolves. All that remains is the Aurum Secretum, crushed to fragments in her own grip.
Her hands are empty, scarred with the searing marks of spent power. The dove is gone.
Understanding crashes over her, and with it, the feeling of falling, endlessly, into a hell of her own making.

steps.speaker: Malicious Whispers
steps.content: Just now... it was you... you strangled her... with your own hands... Just now... it was me... I strangled her... with my own hands...

steps.speaker: Malicious Whispers
steps.content: The more you seek guidance... the more you destroy...
The Underground mark erupts from the deepest layers of her mind. A torrent of whispers surges upward, drowning her consciousness in an instant.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: What... what have I done...
A landscape of pure damnation overtakes her vision.

All matter has been violently fused. Countless fragments of different materials are tangled and melted like wax, each texture a silent testament to a separate, violent origin. Twisted limbs claw toward the sky in a desperate flee, while undulating walls pulse with the compressed layers of distorted, agonized faces.
Hypatia cannot look away. The frenzied energy has commandeered her sight. Even behind closed eyelids, the tableau remains, etched in burning detail.

steps.speaker: Voice of the Dead
steps.content: Hypatia... help us... We haven't fulfilled... that wish.

steps.speaker: Voice of the Dead
steps.content: You promised us a better life, so now, fulfill your promise, or else, join us here...

steps.speaker: Voice of the Dead
steps.content: Give yourself to us...

steps.speaker: Voice of the Dead
steps.content: Will you... kill me too?
As overwhelming noise crashes over her, the twisted dark mist has already crept silently to her feet.
Remorse and anguish stab through her, sharp as a spike. The pain is so visceral she buckles, folding at the waist, barely able to remain upright.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: These are my...
Suddenly, something covers her eyes.
At once, the shouts and pleas fall silent. A weight lifts from her shoulders. Then, faintly, she hears a familiar voice.
Don't look.
That isn't real. Reject it, Hypatia. You can do this.
